summary: Patient missed the appointment because they did not receive a reminder and subsequently forgot the scheduled visit.
recommended_action: Verify patient contact information and confirm enrollment in automated appointment reminder notifications.

summary: Patient missed appointment due to lack of transportation and the clinic's distance from their home.
recommended_action: Provide information on local medical transport services or discuss telehealth options if applicable.

summary: Patient missed the appointment due to financial concerns regarding the consultation fee.
recommended_action: Provide the patient with information regarding available financial assistance programs or sliding scale payment options.
Contact patient to clarify the reason

summary: Patient missed appointment due to high fever and body aches.
recommended_action: Contact patient after a reasonable recovery period to reschedule the appointment.

summary: Patient missed appointment due to an urgent, mandatory work meeting.
recommended_action: Reschedule the appointment to an evening time slot as requested by the patient.

summary: Patient missed the appointment due to forgetting and not receiving an SMS reminder.
recommended_action: Verify patient contact information and ensure SMS reminder system is functioning correctly.

summary: Patient missed appointment due to a city bus strike and lack of available transportation options.
recommended_action: Offer the patient telehealth options or assist in identifying local medical transport services for future visits.

summary: Patient unreachable after three attempts due to phone being switched off.
recommended_action: Send a follow-up letter or secure message to request updated contact information.

summary: Patient missed appointment due to a factory shift change and requested Saturday availability.
recommended_action: Update patient profile to prioritize Saturday appointment slots for future scheduling.
